verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a voice-AI platform, but the evidence pack never documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Retell. Every item describes the hosted Retell workspace, accessed through the dashboard, API, SDKs, CLI, or MCP. Bring-your-own telephony via SIP trunking is an adjacent integration feature, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
